CustomField.description: Lookup to the Form_Component__c record this section is associated with. Provides a relationship to the Form Component definition used by the section; the runtime renders by FormQualifiedApiName / FormConfigJSON rather than dereferencing this lookup. Typically set by the configurator when a Form Component is chosen.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Reference to the Form Component this section is based on. It is normally set for you when you choose a Form in the configurator; you usually do not edit it directly.
CustomField.label: Form Component

lookupFilter.errorMessage: Choose a record Form Component. A component on another object needs a Form Template Mapping to feed the Form Submission; the template record page says when one is missing.
